rv.q: Its binary two-voice structure notwithstanding, 'The Getaway Driver' never let us forget whom the drama's central tragedy hit hardest.
Deborah Salem Smith and Charlie Thurston’s script, incisive staging, and two potent performances turn the evening into a contemporary morality play.
The Getaway Driver has something for everyone.
Otherwise, CST 's "THE GETAWAY DRIVER" is a powerful, impactful story conveyed by two superb actresses.

Though the premise for the show is an intriguing one, the emotional high stakes didn’t capture me until a tearful scene in which Power — who spent 23 years on the run , the longest of any woman in FBI most wanted history — stands before the parole board explaining herself.

cn.t: This tough-minded true-crime drama about political violence and personal responsibility earns praise for its potent performances and moral weight, though reception is mostly positive rather than rapturous.
